fullDesc: In 1984 and 1985 a famine in Ethiopia killed around a million people. A BBC report shocked viewers, and musicians led by Bob Geldof recorded Do They Know It's Christmas, followed by the Live Aid concerts in 1985.
realFacts: Band Aid raised millions for relief
Live Aid reached an audience of nearly 2 billion
Politics and war worsened the famine
USA for Africa recorded We Are the World
